x.gloss: the cardinal number that is the sum of nine and one; the base of the decimal system
the 24th letter of the Roman alphabet

x-ray.gloss: electromagnetic radiation of short wavelength produced when high-speed electrons strike a solid target
a radiogram made by exposing photographic film to X rays; used in medical diagnosis

xenon.gloss: a colorless odorless inert gaseous element occurring in the earth's atmosphere in trace amounts

xhosa.gloss: a member of the Negroid people of southern South Africa
a Bantu language closely related to Zulu, it is the second most common home language in South Africa

xi.gloss: the cardinal number that is the sum of ten and one
the 14th letter of the Greek alphabet

xiii.gloss: the cardinal number that is the sum of twelve and one

xiv.gloss: the cardinal number that is the sum of thirteen and one

xix.gloss: the cardinal number that is the sum of eighteen and one

xv.gloss: the cardinal number that is the sum of fourteen and one

xvi.gloss: the cardinal number that is the sum of fifteen and one

xx.gloss: the cardinal number that is the sum of nineteen and one
(genetics) normal complement of sex chromosomes in a female

xylophone.gloss: a percussion instrument with wooden bars tuned to produce a chromatic scale and with resonators; played with small mallets
